Faq.question: Do you provide professional installation with product purchases?
Faq.answer: Yes, we provide certified professional installation for all ceiling-mounted, wall-mounted, and balcony clothes drying systems.

Faq.question: Do you provide on-site measurements before installation?
Faq.answer: Yes. Our technician visits your home to inspect the ceiling or wall structure and check clearance heights before fitting.

Faq.question: How quickly does the HangerHome team respond to enquiries?
Faq.answer: Our customer support team typically reviews and responds to general enquiries and service requests within 2 to 4 business hours.

Faq.question: What payment options are supported?
Faq.answer: We support Cash on Delivery (COD) as well as secure online payments via Razorpay (UPI, Netbanking, Credit & Debit Cards).
